# kion_billing_source_gcp (Resource)

Manages a Kion GCP Billing Source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_billing_source_gcp" "example" {
  # Required
  account_type_id            = 1
  gcp_billing_account_create = {
    big_query_export = {
      # dataset_name    = "example"
      # focus_view_name = "example"
      # gcp_project_id  = "example"
      # table_format    = "example"
      # table_name      = "example"
    }
    billing_start_date = "2026-01"
    gcp_id             = "example"
    name               = "example"
    service_account_id = 1
    # billing_account_attribution_account_id = 1
    # is_reseller                            = false
    # use_focus                              = false
    # use_proprietary                        = false
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_type_id` (Number) The Account Type ID is the corresponding billing source account's type.
15 - Google Cloud
- `gcp_billing_account_create` (Attributes) GCPBillingAccountWithStart contains fields describing a billing account in GCP (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gcp_billing_account_create))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the GCP billing source.

<a id="nestedatt--gcp_billing_account_create"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gcp_billing_account_create`

Required:

- `big_query_export` (Attributes) GCPBigQueryExport describes information about where billing data is exported in BigQuery (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gcp_billing_account_create--big_query_export))
- `billing_start_date` (String) Start date of the billing source (YYYY-MM).
- `gcp_id` (String) The GCP ID of the billing account
- `name` (String) The name of the Google Cloud billing account
- `service_account_id` (Number) The ID of the service account used for authentication against Google Cloud

Optional:

- `billing_account_attribution_account_id` (Number) The Account ID to attribute untracked charges to
- `is_reseller` (Boolean) Denotes if the billing account is that of a Parent Reseller Billing Account
- `use_focus` (Boolean) Use GCP FOCUS view
- `use_proprietary` (Boolean) Use the GCP Proprietary Billing Table

<a id="nestedatt--gcp_billing_account_create--big_query_export"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gcp_billing_account_create.big_query_export`

Optional:

- `dataset_name` (String) The name of the BigQuery dataset where the export lives
- `focus_view_name` (String) The name of the FOCUS view in BigQuery.
- `gcp_project_id` (String) The ID of the GCP project where the BigQuery dataset lives
- `table_format` (String) The format of the BigQuery table where the export lives.  One of 'auto', 'standard' or 'detailed'.
- `table_name` (String) The name of the BigQuery table where the export lives
